title: Bakery cake cutoff
naturalLanguageRequirements: A cake preorder is accepted only when it is placed before 15:00 on the day before pickup. An order placed after 15:00 is refused. The cutoff time is stated. No second cutoff is left open.
informalMarkdown:
# Functions

## Take a cake preorder

A cake preorder is accepted only when it is placed before 15:00 on the day before pickup. An order placed after 15:00 is refused.

# Data Resources

## Preorder

The preorder records the cake, the customer, and the pickup day.

# Constraints

## Stated cutoff

The cutoff is 15:00 on the day before pickup. This rule is fully stated.
